title: 餐廳用餐
description: 在餐廳用餐時的常用對話

sentences.en: Since this is our first time dining here, could you recommend something that's popular among your regular customers?
sentences.zh: 因為這是我們第一次在這裡用餐，你能推薦一些常客之間受歡迎的菜嗎？

sentences.en: We have a reservation for four under the name Johnson, which was made online earlier this morning.
sentences.zh: 我們有一個以乊森為名的四人訂位，是今天早上在網上預訂的。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to get a table by the window, where we can enjoy the view while having our meal?
sentences.zh: 有沒有可能安排一張靠窗的位子，讓我們可以一邊用餐一邊欣賞風景？

sentences.en: I noticed that the couple sitting next to us ordered a dish that looks absolutely delicious — could you tell me what it is?
sentences.zh: 我注意到旁邊那對夫妻點了一道看起來非常美味的菜——你能告訴我那是什麼嗎？

sentences.en: Before we order our main course, I'd like to know whether the chef has any special recommendations for tonight.
sentences.zh: 在我們點主菜之前，我想知道主廚今晚是否有什麼特別推薦。

sentences.en: My wife, who is allergic to shellfish, would like to confirm that this soup doesn't contain any seafood ingredients.
sentences.zh: 我太太對貝類過敏，她想確認這道湯裡沒有含任何海鮮成分。

sentences.en: Could you please ask the kitchen to prepare my steak medium-rare, with the sauce served on the side instead of on top?
sentences.zh: 能否請廚房把我的牛排做成三分熟，醬汁放旁邊而不是淋在上面？

sentences.en: We're celebrating our anniversary tonight, so we were wondering if you have any special dessert options available.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚在慶祝結婚紀念日，所以想知道你們是否有什麼特別的甜點選項。

sentences.en: The ambiance of this restaurant, which combines modern design with traditional elements, is truly remarkable and inviting.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的氛圍結合了現代設計與傳統元素，真的非常出色且令人嚮往。

sentences.en: I've heard from several friends, all of whom are food enthusiasts, that your pasta dishes are particularly outstanding.
sentences.zh: 我從幾位朋友那裡聽說，他們都是美食愛好者，你們的義大利麵特別出色。

sentences.en: Excuse me, but we've been waiting for over thirty minutes, and our appetizers, which we ordered first, still haven't arrived.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我們已經等了超過三十分鐘，而我們最先點的開胃菜還沒有上來。

sentences.en: Would you mind bringing us some extra napkins and a glass of water with ice, if that's not too much trouble?
sentences.zh: 你介意幫我們多拿一些餐巾紙和一杯加冰的水嗎，如果不會太麻煩的話？

sentences.en: The grilled salmon, which comes with roasted vegetables and a lemon butter sauce, sounds like exactly what I'm in the mood for.
sentences.zh: 烤鮭魚搭配烤蔬菜和檸檬奶油醬，聽起來正是我想吃的。

sentences.en: I'm trying to eat healthier these days, so could you suggest a dish that's both nutritious and low in calories?
sentences.zh: 我最近在努力吃得更健康，所以你能推薦一道既營養又低熱量的菜嗎？

sentences.en: This restaurant, which has been featured in several food magazines, definitely lives up to its excellent reputation.
sentences.zh: 這家曾被多本美食雜誌報導過的餐廳，確實名不虛傳。

sentences.en: Since we have young children with us, could you recommend a few dishes that are mild in flavor and kid-friendly?
sentences.zh: 因為我們帶了小孩，你能推薦幾道口味溫和且適合兒童的菜嗎？

sentences.en: The server, noticing that we seemed confused by the menu, kindly offered to explain each section in detail.
sentences.zh: 服務生注意到我們似乎被菜單搞糊塗了，親切地主動為我們詳細解釋每個部分。

sentences.en: I'd appreciate it if you could let us know when our table is ready, as we'll be waiting in the lounge area.
sentences.zh: 如果桌子準備好了能告訴我們就太好了，因為我們會在休息區等候。

sentences.en: Having dined at numerous restaurants throughout the city, I can honestly say that your service is among the best.
sentences.zh: 在這個城市的許多餐廳用過餐之後，我可以誠實地說你們的服務是最好的之一。

sentences.en: We'd like to split the bill evenly among the four of us, if your payment system allows for that arrangement.
sentences.zh: 我們想把帳單平均分成四份，如果你們的付款系統允許這樣安排的話。

sentences.en: Could you tell me whether the vegetables used in this salad are locally sourced and organic, as I'm quite particular about that?
sentences.zh: 你能告訴我這道沙拉用的蔬菜是否是本地有機的嗎？因為我對這方面很講究。

sentences.en: The portion sizes here are quite generous, which makes the prices very reasonable compared to other restaurants in the area.
sentences.zh: 這裡的份量相當大方，跟這一帶的其他餐廳相比，價格非常合理。

sentences.en: If we decide to add more dishes later, would it be possible to flag down our server without having to leave our seats?
sentences.zh: 如果我們之後決定加點，能不能不用離開座位就叫到我們的服務生？

sentences.en: Everything we've tried so far has been absolutely wonderful, especially the appetizer that came with homemade bread.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止我們嘗試的每一道都非常棒，尤其是搭配自製麵包的開胃菜。

sentences.en: I'm impressed by how quickly the food arrived, considering the restaurant appears to be fully packed this evening.
sentences.zh: 考慮到今晚餐廳看起來完全客滿，上菜速度之快令我印象深刻。

sentences.en: My colleague, who visited this place last week, told me that the chef's special changes daily and is always worth trying.
sentences.zh: 我的同事上週來過這裡，告訴我主廚特餐每天都不同而且總是值得一試。

sentences.en: Before we leave, I'd like to compliment the chef personally, because the meal we just had was truly exceptional.
sentences.zh: 在我們離開之前，我想親自讚美主廚，因為我們剛才吃的這頓飯真的非常出色。

sentences.en: Do you happen to have a private dining room available for next Saturday, when we're planning to host a birthday party?
sentences.zh: 你們下週六剛好有包廂嗎？我們計劃在那天辦一場生日派對。

sentences.en: The dessert menu, which features both classic and seasonal options, looks so tempting that I can't decide what to choose.
sentences.zh: 甜點菜單有經典和季節選項，看起來太誘人了，我無法決定要選什麼。

sentences.en: We thoroughly enjoyed our dining experience tonight, and we will definitely be coming back with more friends next time.
sentences.zh: 我們今晚的用餐體驗非常愉快，下次一定會帶更多朋友再來。
